Monday.Lunch: Rice roti (2 no.) + bitter gourd sabzi (1 medium bowl) + moong dal (1 small bowl)
Monday.Dinner: Tomato soup (1 medium bowl) + Makhana chaat (1 plate)

Tuesday.Wake-up: Ginger & mint water (boil 1 inch ginger & 3-4 mint leaves)
Tuesday.Breakfast: Neer Dosa (2 no.) with veg in batter + Coconut mint/Tomato chutney
Tuesday.Lunch: Moong sprouts and Vegetable Curry with Brown Rice (1 small bowl) + cucumber salad
Tuesday.Evening: Rajgira flakes (2 fist full) + Green/peppermint tea
Tuesday.Dinner: Steamed vegetables (1 big bowl) using olive oil

Wednesday.Breakfast: Green moong dosa (2 no.) + Tomato chutney (2 tsp)
Wednesday.Lunch: Parboiled rice and yellow moong khichdi + Buttermilk (add ½ tsp jeera powder)
Wednesday.Bedtime: Chamomile tea Or Star anise water

Thursday.Breakfast: Oats dosa with veggies on top + mint chutney
Thursday.Lunch: Rice roti/bhakri (2 no.) + bottle gourd/beetroot sabzi + moong dal (1 small bowl)
Thursday.Dinner: Sauteed mushroom and baby corn (250g) with seasonal green leafy vegetables

Friday.Wake-up: Ash gourd/bottle gourd juice (300ml - drink without straining)
Friday.Lunch: Kerala Rice (1 medium bowl) + Lauki sabzi + buttermilk (add pinch of hing)
Friday.Dinner: Drumstick/Carrot soup (1 medium bowl) + steamed green moong (1 medium bowl)
Friday.Bedtime: Chamomile tea Or Star anise water

Saturday.Breakfast: Steamed sweet potato chaat (1 medium bowl)
Saturday.Lunch: Rice roti (2 no.) + mix veg sabzi (1 medium bowl) + Buttermilk (add ½ tsp jeera powder)
Saturday.Evening: Coconut water with malai / Green tea / peppermint tea
Saturday.Dinner: Moong dal chilla (2 no.) + mint chutney

Sunday.Breakfast: Rice ganji (add pinch of cinnamon) OR Vegetable red rice poha
Sunday.Lunch: Vegetable pulao (1 medium bowl) + buttermilk (add pinch of hing)
Sunday.Dinner: Moong dal and beetroot tikki (4 no.) + sauteed veggies
Sunday.Bedtime: Chamomile tea Or Star anise water
